title: They Hyper Power Combo Pack
author: Nuruddin N.
desc:
Working on building muscle as well as strength! Using the Faz Lifts 8s - 5s - 3s Progression on main lifts!

Bench press for example.

Let's say you start with 85% of your 5rm which is 135lbs

Week 1 is 3x8 @135lbs - adding 5lbs to the bar every week... Stay at 3 sets of 8, until you fail to get 8 reps on that last set. The next week move to 2x8, adding 5lbs to the bar each week, until the 2nd set you only get 6 or 7 reps. Then the next week down to 1 set of 8...adding 5lbs each week until you can't get 8.

The next week...still adding 5lbs we are now in the 3x5 phase. Same thing all the way down to 1x5.

Then it's the 3x3 phase...still adding 5lbs every week, all the way down to 1x3

Then start all over close, or a little over your last 1x8 weight.

Double progression on the accessory lifts, and adding when when applicable. Dial in on form and technique, and the progressive overload will come on its own!
